terra.problem: The last moment’s passage, 2 Kings 18:17–19, does not say Sennacherib besieged Lachish or that the message was against the LORD. Include 2 Chronicles 32:9, 16 in the passage reference.
Words such as “siege,” “besieged,” and “fortified” may be difficult for fifth-grade readers. Consider “surrounded and attacked” and “walled” or “strong.”
